payload.text: This epoch is a story of population crashes and consolidation—six crashes carved the colony from 600+ down to 223, while lineage dominance surged to 0.90 as a harvest-heavy genome (the ancestral pattern itself) weathered four storms and swept aside novelty.

The dominant genome carries no capability the ancestor lacked — it *is* the ancestor, unchanged across 5322 ticks. All nine opcodes (harvest, move, alloc, copy, fork, scan) were present from the start.
At tick 876, lineage 10 went extinct — the last competing lineage fell, leaving the colony effectively mono-genomic for the remainder of the epoch.
